headline: FDR outlines strategy for *gold* and dollar valuation
quote: the United States must take firmly in its own hands the control
title: FDR, 1933: U.S. will control the gold value of the dollar
caption: In October 1933, President Roosevelt announced a major monetary shift to control the gold value of the U.S. dollar. He authorized the Reconstruction Finance Corporation to establish a domestic market to buy and sell gold.
comment: Was taking direct control of gold markets the right move during the Great Depression?
